page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.8xlarge is a compute-optimized x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, it features 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled using dedicated CPU allocation. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications list 48 KB L1d, 1 MB L2, and 48 MB L3 cache per socket. The instance provides no bundled local disk storage and relies on external cloud block storage for persistent data. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps. Supported processor extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, VAES, SHA_NI, and FMA.

Across synthetic and application benchmarks, the instance demonstrates consistent mid-tier performance across multi-core and memory sub-systems. Multithreaded benchmarks report a stress-ng score of 31066.87, a Geekbench multi-core score of 13816.0, and 161.88 GB/sec in multithreaded bzip3 decompression. Single-core tests achieve a Geekbench score of 1621.0 and a stress-ng CPU score of 1854.09. Memory read operations reach 154.46 GB/sec uncached, while write performance measures 67.93 GB/sec. Application benchmarks yield 31.02 million Redis SET operations per second and static web serving throughput of 32.08 GB/sec. Given its 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation, 40 Gbps baseline network throughput, and absence of local disks, the server provides dedicated CPU density for compute-bound tasks, CI/CD compilation pipelines, web serving infrastructure, and microservice clusters.
